newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor, Citibank in talks on spot trading.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor, Citibank in talks on spot trading.

text.p: The state-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) said it had started preliminary talks with Citibank N.A. for the use of the latter's facilities to trade its surplus power daily in the spot market.
Napocor officials said on Monday officials of both firms were discussing a possible link-up of a software application created by Napocor for the proposed spot market trading.
Napocor is the Philippines' biggest producer of power. It is entering into short and long-term contracts for the sale of the electricity it generates.
The officials said if the parties arrive at an agreement, Napocor can undertake a pilot test of its spot market trading as soon as July.
Napocor president Guido Delgado had earlier said Napocor was planning not only to sell surplus power but also to trade the excess electricity in the futures market.
